policy: Les obligations structurelles ci-dessous sont fermes. Les seuils de distribution/performance se figent sur calibration avant holdout, avec approbation intégrateur et justification gameplay. Aucune valeur mesurée inventée.

to_freeze.acceptance: Bounds by profile and progression matrix before holdout
Ranges by climate and terrain profile; no universal high fertility at rivers
Per resource and world profile; after final cavity masks
Metrics plus human counter-review on independent seeds
Controlled-date/weather loaded-vs-unloaded protocol, bounded convergence period
Reference hardware/profiles in quality-budgets plus new component breakdown

freeze_rule: No required value may remain null at final qualification. Definition of Done for early catalog/model tasks does not itself certify the final corpus.
